related.title: xv6：系統呼叫與使用者／核心邊界
related.titleEn: xv6: system calls and user/kernel boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付可重播的排程表與不變量證明；明示此為交錯模型而非執行緒效能量測。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver a replayable schedule and invariant argument; label it an interleaving model rather than a thread-performance measurement. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 畫出user wrapper、trap、dispatch、copyin/copyout與return；以半開區間檢查整段而非起點。
related.differenceEn: Map wrapper, trap, dispatch, copyin/copyout and return; validate the entire half-open span instead of only its start.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
條件變數等待必須在互斥鎖保護下反覆檢查predicate；喚醒是重新檢查的機會，不是資源保證。
本課數值核對：6-2 = 4 items；另一項核對：1-1 = 0 items。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

系統呼叫經trap轉入核心；使用者傳入的位址仍需檢查。教學核心揭露機制，不等同正式平台安全保證。
本課數值核對：8188+8-8192 = 4 B；另一項核對：8192-8188 = 4 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Condition waits recheck a predicate in a loop under its mutex; waking is an opportunity to recheck, not a resource grant.
Numeric audit: 6-2 = 4 items; second audit: 1-1 = 0 items. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

A system call traps into the kernel; user-supplied addresses still require validation. A teaching kernel reveals mechanisms, not production security guarantees.
Numeric audit: 8188+8-8192 = 4 B; second audit: 8192-8188 = 4 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Linux mmap：頁面對齊與映射視窗
related.titleEn: Linux mmap: alignment and mapped windows
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付可重播的排程表與不變量證明；明示此為交錯模型而非執行緒效能量測。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver a replayable schedule and invariant argument; label it an interleaving model rather than a thread-performance measurement. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 畫檔案、映射區與可見slice三個半開區間；在delta後開始處理資料。
related.differenceEn: Draw half-open file, mapped and visible-slice intervals; start processing after delta.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
條件變數等待必須在互斥鎖保護下反覆檢查predicate；喚醒是重新檢查的機會，不是資源保證。
本課數值核對：6-2 = 4 items；另一項核對：1-1 = 0 items。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

檔案映射offset需符合系統頁對齊要求；所需子區段可用對齊起點加delta表示。映射成功不代表所有頁已載入。
本課數值核對：5000-floor(5000/4096)*4096 = 904 B；另一項核對：904+3000 = 3904 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Condition waits recheck a predicate in a loop under its mutex; waking is an opportunity to recheck, not a resource grant.
Numeric audit: 6-2 = 4 items; second audit: 1-1 = 0 items. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

File mapping offsets must satisfy system page alignment; a subrange is represented by an aligned start plus delta. Successful mapping does not mean all pages are loaded.
Numeric audit: 5000-floor(5000/4096)*4096 = 904 B; second audit: 904+3000 = 3904 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
